text: marta: I pushed a compact-layout experiment that tightens chart gutters and adds a "Highlight top percentile" toggle for sparklines. Need quick design + a11y sanity check. ezra: Looks great visually. My main worry: when smoothing is on, short spikes disappear. Users relying on visual peaks could miss anomalies. jin: Proposal: always compute extremes from raw samples and render them on a separate marker layer. Visual options: small haloed dot, translucent percentile band, or an anomaly chip in the legend when too many points. ops: Engineering note: extra marker layer should be GPU-composited. We'll emit rawIndices in the chart payload so markers map to real samples. Also cap markers (e.g., show dots when <=5 anomalies) to avoid clutter. ux-bot: Copy suggestion: label the control "Highlight top percentile (95%)" so non-technical users see the value. Advanced settings can expose the percentile. a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist: sparklines need an accessible name (aria-label), a live summary region, and keyboard focus. Legend toggles must use role="button" + aria-pressed and include the percentile in the label. Color-only indicators need a shape or pattern. marta: For marker design: hollow circle 4px, 2px halo, token = warning-500. For very dense cases switch to a 2px vertical bar. Hit target should be 24px. ezra: Tooltip microcopy: show "value (raw)" when overlay present; when smoothing is enabled show both "value (raw)" and "value (smoothed)" and a small delta. jin: Legend overflow behavior: in narrow widths move labels to an overflow menu that lists series + latest value + anomaly count. Don't truncate mid-word. a11y-bot: Suggested ARIA snippet for docs: ``` Sparkline (cache hits): min 0.01, median 0.2, max 1.5. 3 points above 95th percentile. ``` ux-bot: Also add `tabindex=0` to the sparkline container and `aria-describedby` linking to the legend chip for anomaly counts; pressing Enter should open a details panel. ops: I'll add `renderAnomalies: raw|smoothed|both` and `anomalyPercentile` flags to the chart API. Default = raw + 95. I'll enforce a marker cap at 6 and fallback to the legend chip. marta: Acceptance criteria I'll add to the ticket: default highlighting on (raw-based), markers shown when <=6 anomalies else show chip, aria-live summary present, legend toggles tabbable with aria-pressed, tooltips labeled raw/smoothed, composited layers for perf. ezra: Nit: settings copy should read "Highlight top percentile (95%)" (not "95th") to be clearer. a11y-bot: +1. Test with VoiceOver and NVDA, ensure the live region fires on focus. marta: Thanks all. I'll update the PR and ping for a final pass. ezra: :thumbsup:
